steps.what: Maintain library photocopiers, scanners, and computers
Instruct patrons in the proper use of such equipment
Open the stored fault note for that equipment

tasks.design: The assistant maintains photocopiers, scanners, and computers, and instructs patrons in their proper use. {DOCS} opens the fault note when the equipment identifier is stored. A missing note stays blank, and the assistant deals with the machine.
tasks.previous_blocker: Faults were remembered, and each patron was shown the same steps from scratch.
tasks.enabler_now: A known machine can open the last fault note.
tasks.still_hard: Clearing a jam, replacing paper, and standing with the patron stay physical.
tasks.human_edge: The assistant stops a machine that is unsafe and does not send the patron back to it.
tasks.altitude: Maintenance and instruction stay the week. The fault note is only a reminder.

reach.task: Repair a machine the assistant cannot clear
reach.learn: Which faults must be left for facilities.

evidence.claim: A stored equipment identifier can open a fault note. Clearing the machine and instructing the patron stay manual.

assumptions: The work starts with a fault or a patron at a machine and ends when it is usable or handed to facilities.
A fault row has equipment identifier and note, entered by the assistant after a previous fault. A missing row is left blank.
No remote fix is claimed. Upkeep is correcting the note after this visit.
unknowns: Which machines the assistant is allowed to open.
research_questions: How often was the fault note wrong for the machine in front of the assistant?

already_counted.description: Maintaining photocopiers, scanners, and computers is already in the assistant's step.

incremental.description: Correct the fault note after the assistant clears or escalates the machine.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Low: fault notes are missing, so the assistant works as today. High: known machines open a note, and the repair and the instruction remain. The range stays under the net.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Schedule, supervise, and train library workers

steps.what: Show stored availability for library employees
Schedule clerical workers, volunteers, and student assistants
Supervise workers and other library employees on the shift
Train student assistants and volunteers on the desk

tasks.design: The assistant schedules clerical workers, volunteers, and student assistants, supervises the shift, and trains them. {CALENDAR} shows stored availability. The assistant writes the rota. A missing availability stays blank. The rota is names and hours only. It does not score anyone.
tasks.previous_blocker: Availability was collected by asking, and the rota was rebuilt from memory.
tasks.enabler_now: Availability can be a stored row the assistant reads before writing the rota.
tasks.still_hard: Choosing who works, supervising the shift, and training stay with the assistant.
tasks.human_edge: The assistant will not treat a blank availability as a free hour, and does not score the person.
tasks.altitude: Supervision and training stay. The assistant sees who is free before writing the rota.

reach.task: Set the desk coverage the rota must meet
reach.learn: Which hours a student assistant may not cover alone.

evidence.claim: Stored availability can be shown as names and hours. A missing row stays blank.

Writing a rota and supervising staff is the assistant's judgement. The design does not score workers. Where a works council must be consulted before staff schedules are systematised, that consultation happens first. National rules differ.

assumptions: The work starts with the coming week's coverage and ends with a rota, a supervised shift, or a training session.
An availability row has person identifier and free hours, entered by that person or the assistant. A blank row is not treated as free.
No performance score is stored. Supervision time is not reduced.
unknowns: Whether volunteers are on the same availability list as employees.
research_questions: How often did the assistant override the shown availability?

already_counted.description: Supervising library employees on the shift is already in the assistant's step.

incremental.description: Correct an availability row after the person says the hours were wrong.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Low: availability is incomplete, so the rota is still built by asking. High: availability is filled, and supervision and training remain in full. The range stays under the net.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Repair books or prepare them for the bindery

steps.what: Repair books using mending tape, paste, and brushes
Prepare books to be sent to a bindery for repair

tasks.design: The assistant repairs books with mending tape, paste, and brushes, or prepares them for a bindery. Nothing in the repair is calculated or sent by a system. A bindery slip, if used, is written by the assistant.
tasks.previous_blocker: The repair was always done by hand, and it still is.
tasks.enabler_now: No new stored field makes tape, paste, or a bindery parcel faster.
tasks.still_hard: The whole repair and the packing stay physical.
tasks.human_edge: The assistant decides that a book should go to the bindery rather than be mended at the desk.
tasks.altitude: Nothing changes. Mending and bindery packing stay with the assistant.

reach.task: Decide that a title is worth binding
reach.learn: Which damage the librarian wants sent out.

evidence.claim: Mending a book and packing it for a bindery are physical. No stored field shortens them.

assumptions: The work starts with a damaged book and ends when it is mended or packed for the bindery.
No new record is required. A missing title does not block the repair.
Upkeep is zero because no new list is kept.
unknowns: Which bindery the library uses, and what must be written on the parcel.
research_questions: How many books were mended at the desk, and how many were packed for the bindery?

already_counted.description: Repairing books with tape, paste, and brushes is already in the assistant's step.

incremental.description: No new upkeep: the repair adds no record.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Low: every book is still mended or packed by hand. High: the same hand work remains, with no new step removed. No upkeep is added, so the low does not go below zero. The range stays under the net.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Deal with disruptive or problem patrons

steps.what: Take action with disruptive or problem patrons

tasks.design: The assistant deals with a disruptive or problem patron in the room. No record is required before the assistant acts, and no system speaks for them.
tasks.previous_blocker: The situation is in the room, and it still is.
tasks.enabler_now: Nothing stored removes the need to be there.
tasks.still_hard: The whole conversation and the decision stay with the assistant.
tasks.human_edge: The assistant judges the room and asks a librarian or a guard when the situation needs them.
tasks.altitude: Nothing changes. The assistant still handles the incident in person.

reach.task: Take over an incident the desk should not handle alone
reach.learn: Which situations must be escalated at once.

evidence.claim: Dealing with a disruptive patron is a conversation in the room. It is not a stored lookup.

assumptions: The work starts when a patron disrupts the room and ends when the assistant has acted or handed it on.
No new record is required to act. A later note, if the library wants one, is a separate task.
Upkeep is zero. The design does not score patrons.
unknowns: Who the assistant must call, and under what house rule.
research_questions: How often was the incident handed to a librarian or a guard?

already_counted.description: Dealing with the disruptive patron is already the whole of the assistant's step.

incremental.description: No new upkeep: the incident adds no standing record.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Low: every incident is still handled in the room. High: the same in-person action remains, with no step removed. No upkeep is added, so the low does not go below zero. The range stays under the net.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: The assistant still meets patrons, shelves items, and handles cash. A record, notice, invoice, or order is written or sent only after the assistant accepts that version.
reach: A librarian receives the question the assistant could not answer from the desk.
A finance colleague receives only an invoice the assistant has accepted.
skills_to_grow: Stop when a required field is blank.
Accept or refuse the exact version before a send or a write.
Keep shelving, cash, and patron conversations in their own hands.
role.ambitious_version: Every item on loan has a location and a due date the desk can trust, and the assistant still decides the exception.
